IC1: Eligible patients must meet the following criteria to be enrolled in the study:
IC2: 1. Newly diagnosed, stage IV squamous cell lung cancer. This includes patients who present with disseminated metastases, and those with a malignant pleural [OR] or pericardial effusion (i.e., formerly stage IIIB in the 6th TNM staging system).
IC3: 2. Patients who have received prior adjuvant therapy for early-stage lung cancer [AND] are eligible if at least 12 months have elapsed from that treatment.
IC4: 3. Histologically [AND] confirmed squamous cell bronchogenic carcinoma. Patients whose tumors contain mixed non-small cell histologies [AND] are eligible, as long as squamous carcinoma is the predominant histology. Mixed tumors with [NOT] small cell anaplastic elements are not eligible. Cytologic specimens obtained by brushings, washings, or needle aspiration of the defined lesion are acceptable.
IC5: 4. Patients with previous radiotherapy [AND] as definitive therapy for locally advanced non-small cell lung cancer are eligible, as long as the recurrence is outside the original radiation therapy port. Radiation therapy must have been completed >4 weeks prior to the initiation of study treatment. Patients who have received  chemo [OR]/radiation for locally advanced NSCLC are [NOT] not eligible. Patients who have received palliative radiation therapy [AND] for symptomatic metastases must have completed treatment >14 days prior the initiation of the study treatment.
IC6: 5. Presence of evaluable (measureable or non-measurable) disease.
IC9: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) >1,500/microL and platelets >100,000/microL (≤72 hours prior to initial treatment).
IC10: Hemoglobin >9 g/dL (Note: Patients may be transfused or receive erythropoietin to maintain or exceed this level).
IC12: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) ≤2.5 times the upper limit of normal if [NOT] no liver involvement [OR] or ≤5 times the upper limit of normal with liver involvement.
IC13: Creatinine <2.0 mg/dL,  [OR] or creatinine clearance >40 mL/min (as calculated by the Cockcroft-Gault method.
IC14: 8. Women of childbearing potential must have a negative serum pregnancy test performed within 7 days prior to start of treatment. Women of childbearing potential or men with partners of childbearing potential must use effective birth control measures during treatment and at least 6 months after the last dose of the study treatment. If a woman becomes pregnant or suspects she is pregnant while participating in this study, she must agree to inform her treating physician immediately. Sexually active men must agree to use a medically acceptable form of birth control during treatment and at least 6 months after the last dose. If a female partner becomes pregnant during the course of the study the treating physician should be informed immediately.
IC16: 10. Ability to understand the nature of this study, give written informed consent, and comply with study requirements.
IC17: 11. Patients entering this study must be willing to provide tissue from a previous tumor biopsy (if available) for correlative testing. An exception to this is when the national/local regulations prohibits some of the key activities of this research like the export of samples to third countries, storage of coded samples or global gene expression profiling without a pre-specified list of target genes. If tissue is [NOT] not available, a patient will still be eligible for enrollment into the study.
